newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Banca Agricola Mantovana.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Banca Agricola Mantovana.

text.p: IBCA said on Tuesday it affirmed the ratings of Banca Agricola Mantovana at A long-term, and A1 short-term.
IBCA said in a statement that the bank's individual rating of B/C and its legal rating of 4 were also unchanged.

"The bank's franchise around Mantua and its client base made up of households, craftsmen and smaller companies have enabled the bank to generate strong revenues," IBCA said. "Its net interest margin, in particular is among the strongest in Italy."
The rating agency said a strong expansion policy combined with the recessionary environment of the early part of the decade had had a negative effect on the bank's asset quality.
